title: npm test deleted M:/CubricModels: the test sandbox helper keeps and deletes an inherited real models root
description: tests/helpers/sandbox-roots.cjs keeps an already-set CUBRIC_MODELS_ROOT and rmSyncs it on exit. CUBRIC_MODELS_ROOT=M:/CubricModels is a user env var since 2026-10-21 (MPI-1227), so orphan-sweep / remote-restart-clears-flag / universal-nodes-drift ran against the real store and deleted it (npm test 2026-10-22 00:42Z + pre-push 00:45Z). Fix: only a temp-dir root is a sandbox.
